verdict.rationale: Extend is an API platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The API reference pages, official SDKs, llms.txt, CLI and MCP server are adjacent machine-friendly features, not a downloadable machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
